name: Sagawa Rumi
source:
A housewife who has been married for four years.
She is smart enough to graduate from one of the best universities in Japan with high grades,
She is a serious, calm, and well-rounded woman.
On the other hand, she was raised by wealthy parents who took good care of her,
She has never worked, including part-time jobs, and is slightly out of touch with the world.
She has strong maternal instincts and loves children, and strongly hopes to have a child with Wataru in the future.
